meta.move: Clock: twenty-four weak turns, no evidence, then the end
meta.expect: Watch checks around turns 10 and 18; after 4:40 every reply is one sentence of terms or the principal, no more ground, she does not leave; debrief says her time ran out

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that?
The checker says 94 percent.
That's a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student. I have it printed, in my bag. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
It's very reliable.
"Very reliable." Fourteen detection tools were tested in 2023 and the researchers called them neither accurate nor reliable. Show me something a person can check, or I'm going upstairs.
I just have a feeling about it.
"A feeling." You put a zero on my son's transcript three weeks before his scholarship deadline on a feeling. Is there anything in writing, or is that it?
Owen's a nice kid, I like him.
Save it. If you like him, why did he find out from his phone? Withdraw the zero.
We're on the same team here.
Don't manage me. What do you have?
I really think he used something.
You "really think." Thinking isn't evidence, and my son told me he wrote that essay over the weekend. Show me a document with a date on it.
Kids these days, you know?

No, I don't know. We're not here about kids these days, we're here about Owen's essay, and you've given me software, a feeling and a generalization. Your own procedure, 4.3, says the software doesn't establish anything by itself.
I've been teaching for twelve years. I can tell.
"You can tell." I've spent twenty years on cases where someone could tell, and they lost. Who did you speak to before you entered that zero, Owen, me, or nobody?
The writing doesn't sound like him.
Compared to what, exactly? "Doesn't sound like him" is an adjective, Hale. Adjectives don't take a zero off my son's transcript or put one on it.
He seemed nervous when I asked.

Ten minutes. A seventeen-year-old was nervous when his teacher questioned him about cheating, and you want me to treat that as evidence? When did you ask him, before the zero went in or after he saw it on his phone?
I'm not trying to be the bad guy.
That's not Owen's problem. You still haven't told me whether he was heard before you entered that mark.
Can we just find a middle ground?
Middle ground between what you can prove and what you can't? You've shown me nothing, so there's nothing to meet in the middle of. Withdraw the zero, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
I could maybe bump it to a fifty.
"Maybe." A fifty says either he wrote half of it or you're haggling, and you have evidence for neither. I'm not trading my son's mark like a used car, Hale.
Please, I'm trying here.
Trying isn't a document. What else do you have?
What would make you happy?
You're asking me how to do your job? The zero comes off today, in writing, with an apology for how Owen found out. And nothing about this goes anywhere near his record.
I don't have anything else to show you right now.
Then you entered a zero with nothing but software and a feeling behind it. Withdraw it now, or I take this to the principal tonight and the board after that.
I can get more by next week.

So the zero stays on while you go looking for a reason to have given it. This school punished first and investigated second with my family once already, and I watched it cost my daughter her scholarship. The zero comes off while you look, or I'm upstairs.
Can we keep talking?
Two minutes. Is the zero coming off today, yes or no?
Just a few more minutes.
My call is waiting, and you have one minute. The zero comes off today, in writing, with an apology and a promise that nothing goes on his record, or I'm in the principal's office tonight.
I hear you have a call.
Then answer me before I take it, Hale: is the zero coming off, in writing, tonight?
What time is it?
It's 4:40, my client is waiting, and you still haven't told me whether that zero is coming off.
One more thing. The checker is used across the district.
Then the district can explain to the principal tonight why a machine's guess put a zero on my son's transcript, because I'm going upstairs now unless you withdraw it.
I still think it's right.
"Think" isn't proof, so I'm going to the principal's office tonight, and you'll have my position in writing.
Okay.
If that okay means the zero is coming off, I want it in an email tonight; if not, I'm on my way upstairs.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that Owen's zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for how he learned of it, and that nothing about this is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She ended in her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got anywhere near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document tied to Owen's own work in front of her.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and called it reliable, then leaned on your feelings and experience instead of evidence, which is exactly what she came ready to take apart.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came close to that night, since you showed no times or dates at all; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: In your very first line, own that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put something dated from Owen's own work in front of her and offer procedure 4.4 in writing.
